BIBLE-2tj: as of 2026-08-12 commit 215f290. 24 content files + 8 ADRs. STAGE 17 done: 00q-circumcision-covenant-sign-and-heart.md. Methodology now v1.1.

ALWAYS READ 00-methodology-current.md FIRST BEFORE INGESTING ANY TRANCHE. v1.1 added: EXTRABIBLICAL SOURCE PROTOCOL + LOCALIZATION POLICY + KNOWN TECHNICAL DEBT section.

STAGE 17 — CIRCUMCISION. Easy answer fails: circumcision PREDATES MOSES (Gen 17, Abrahamic not Levitical). Gen 15:6 credits righteousness TWO CHAPTERS before Gen 17's sign — Rom 4:10 is chronological exegesis of Genesis not Pauline invention; sign real, covenant real, but FAITH PRECEDED THE SIGN. Sidebar: order of causation != dispensability (Gen 17:14 'cut off' stands). TORAH ITSELF MOVES CIRCUMCISION INWARD BEFORE PAUL: Deut 10:16 commands it OF THE ALREADY-CIRCUMCISED (physical membership != faithful heart), Deut 30:6 turns command into PROMISE (Yahweh will circumcise), Jer 4:4, Jer 9:26 'ALL the house of Israel are uncircumcised in heart'.

ACTS 15 CATEGORY COLLAPSE CHECKPOINT: disputed proposition is NARROW — must GENTILE believers be circumcised to be saved/incorporated? NOT 'is circumcision evil' or 'may Jewish believers circumcise sons'. Acts 15:9 'cleansed their HEARTS by faith' classified precisely: Tier A = NO citation formula, Acts does not quote Deuteronomy; Tier B strong = same trajectory (heart transformation + divine action + covenant inclusion). Neither error permitted. Acts 15:11 DIRECTION: Peter says 'WE will be saved... just as THEY will' not 'they are saved like us' — all three witnesses preserve it.

TIMOTHY/TITUS CONTROL CASE (the thing that settles it): Timothy circumcised (Acts 16:3, contextual/missionary); Titus's circumcision RESISTED (Gal 2:3-5, compulsion would concede a false covenantal requirement). ONLY contradictory if circumcision itself is the issue; perfectly coherent once the issue is what it's made to SIGNIFY. Argument from narrative, not assertion.

BOTH OVER-READINGS OF ACTS 15 REFUSED: 'Gentiles have only four commandments' (not what text says) AND 'Acts 15:21 means progressive Gentile Torah observance' (known reading, worth investigating, BUT IT IS INFERENCE and must be labeled one). Open q 26.

ROMANS 2:28 EXPLICITLY RESTRAINED — cuts against us: must NOT be used to erase ethnic Israel while claiming to oppose replacement theology (same error in reverse). NOT load-bearing. Safer case = Rom 11 grafting / Eph 2 brought near / Gal 3 heirs. Relevant to the 'Messianic Israelite' term which was already disciplined once at Stage 5.

PAUL'S THREE FORMULATIONS CONVERGE (open q 27, carried forward unresolved): 1 Cor 7:19 'keeping the commandments of God' / Gal 5:6 'faith working through love' / Gal 6:15 'a new creation' — same construction, three completions. Reads as new creation -> faith -> love -> obedience, echoing Ezekiel's new heart -> Spirit -> obedience. AT 'SUPPORTS' NOT 'ESTABLISHES'. Still unresolved because Paul never defines 'commandments of God' in context; needs cross-letter usage study.

GAL 3:29 one of the strongest texts: inheritance located IN MESSIAH so Gentiles need no physical circumcision to be Abraham's heirs. Does NOT erase Abraham — makes Messiah the point through whom the blessing reaches the nations (Gen 12).

THE STAGE'S REAL FINDING: sacrifice changed FORM; priesthood changed ORDER; circumcision's PHYSICAL SIGN ceased functioning as the necessary Gentile boundary while heart-circumcision became central. THREE DIFFERENT TRANSFORMATIONS. NO MECHANICAL FORMULA. Messiah fulfills different elements according to their PARTICULAR SCRIPTURAL PURPOSE. Retroactively vindicates Stage 16 section 18's preemptive brake — the model was a possibility framework and the very next test case proved it by not matching.

NEW BOOKMARK 'OLAM' (open q 25) WITH HARD BRAKE: berit olam (Gen 17:13) vs transformed function forces the lexical question. ESV/CJB 'everlasting' (metaphysical lean) vs RVR1960 'PERPETUO' (durational lean) — translations already split before analysis. Stakes exceed circumcision (priestly statutes, festivals, land, Yahweh Himself). DO NOT RESOLVE OLAM OPPORTUNISTICALLY — it is the single most tempting shortcut available; a convenient reading would relieve several pressures at once INCLUDING Ezekiel 37:26's sanctuary (open q 19). 'A word study conducted in order to relieve a pressure is not a word study; it is advocacy with a lexicon.'

1 ENOCH NOW VERIFIED (was wrongly recorded as VERIFICATION FAILED at Stage 16 after ONE endpoint 403'd). Took 4 attempts: sacred-texts 403 -> archive.org 404 -> Wikisource index (TOC only) -> WIKISOURCE CHAPTER PAGES = SUCCESS (Charles translation). CONFIRMED: 1En 6:3 'Semjaza, who was their leader' voices the fear; THE OTHERS propose the oath — AZAZEL DOES NOT LEAD IT, though he is among the chiefs (as Asael), is THE figure singled out in ch8 (swords/knives/metals/bracelets/antimony/eyelids), and is named first in ch10:4 'Bind Azazel hand and foot... make an opening in the desert, which is in DUDAEL' with rough jagged rocks placed on him. RASHI VERIFIED via Sefaria API: Azazel = 'a precipitous and flinty rock — a towering peak', from azaz (strong) + el (mighty). BOTH TRADITIONS locate Azazel in a ROCKY WILDERNESS — Rashi as a PLACE, Enoch as a PERSON confined in such a place. Observation not proof. SEMANTIC FORK PRESERVED (cliff / removal / place / personal being) — do not collapse. STILL UNCHECKED: 1 Enoch manuscript-language status by section (Qumran Aramaic vs later Ethiopic) — bookmarked.

NEW FORMAL RULE from that: FAILED ACCESS TO ONE SOURCE IS NOT VERIFICATION FAILURE until alternate stable editions/manuscript witnesses have been attempted. Source hierarchy: (1) biblical text directly — Sefaria API works where its HTML doesn't; (2) stable public-domain critical edition (Wikisource chapter pages, Internet Archive); (3) corroborate against Qumran/DSS. THREE-CLAIM DISTINCTION never conflate: '1 Enoch says X' vs 'Second Temple Jews believed X' vs 'Leviticus means X'.

ADR-0008 SOURCE-LANGUAGE-FIRST LOCALIZATION (new): research ONCE at source-language level, render separately per edition. English research witnesses = ESV + CJB by default. RVR1960 pulled SELECTIVELY during research when: Spanish wording materially differs / translation choice is part of the argument / verse is central to both editions / Spanish terminology creates a distinctive theological assumption. Otherwise defer to the Spanish pass. BINDING RULE: Spanish manuscript must be LOCALIZED FROM THE SOURCE-OF-TRUTH RESEARCH, not translated mechanically from the English manuscript; biblical quotations from RVR1960 directly; where an argument depends on Hebrew/Aramaic/Greek, preserve that analysis identically across editions. Every stage file now carries a 'localization:' frontmatter field. Caught a real divergence on FIRST application (berit olam).

It's an audit pass not a reconstruction (files exist, spine records connections). TIMING DELIBERATE: not now (method still stabilizing, 1.0->1.1 in one day, would audit twice), not at the end (later chapters would be stricter than opening ones). Run once methodology holds steady several stages, BEFORE manuscript foundation is locked.

NEXT STAGE 18: CLEAN AND UNCLEAN FOOD. NOT 'can Christians eat pork' — too loaded, presumes categories. THE QUESTION: what purpose do clean/unclean distinctions serve in Torah, what precedes Sinai, what does Yeshua actually say about food and defilement, what does Peter's vision ACTUALLY mean in Acts 10, and what do the apostles subsequently require or not require of Gentiles? SURPRISE ALREADY WAITING: the clean/unclean distinction ALSO PREDATES MOSES — Noah knows it in Genesis 7. So 'merely Mosaic Law' fails for the SECOND CONSECUTIVE STAGE. CARRIED FORWARD DELIBERATELY: if both circumcision AND clean/unclean predate Sinai, how much of what is casually called 'the Mosaic Law' originates there at all? Not stage 18's question but now visible and not to be lost. Acts 10:28 already established: Peter's own stated interpretation concerns PEOPLE — but disproving 'pork is clean now' does NOT prove dietary law binds Gentiles (Anti-Replacement).

COVENANT DEFINITION — locked 2026-08-12, Stage 16.5, file 00r-what-is-a-covenant.md (commit cba470e).

berit (Hebrew) / diatheke (Greek). A covenant = a solemn, binding RELATIONSHIP established by commitments or promises — parties, obligations, signs, blessings, consequences, sometimes oath or sacrifice. Idiom: one CUTS a covenant (karat berit), tying covenant to sacrifice at vocabulary level (Gen 15's divided animals).

CORE DISTINCTION: THE COVENANT IS NOT IDENTICAL TO THE COMMANDMENTS ASSOCIATED WITH IT. A covenant contains obligations; obligations are not its definition.

SEVEN TERMS HELD APART (conflating = Category Collapse): COVENANT (the relational arrangement) / PROMISE (what Yahweh commits to accomplish) / COMMANDMENT (what Yahweh commands) / COVENANT OBLIGATION-STIPULATION (what a particular arrangement requires) / COVENANT SIGN (visible marker) / COVENANT BLESSING / COVENANT CURSE.

SHARPENING: covenant != promise. A covenant contains promises but is more relational and structured. EVERY COVENANT INVOLVES COMMITMENTS; NOT EVERY PROMISE IS A COVENANT.

'SHABBAT IS THE COVENANT' IS IMPRECISE — Shabbat is named a covenant SIGN (Ex 31:17), as are the rainbow (Gen 9:12-13) and circumcision (Gen 17:11). NOTE FOR THE LATER SHABBAT STAGE, DELIBERATELY NOT CASHED: Ex 31:17 roots Shabbat in CREATION, not only Sinai.

EIGHT STRUCTURAL QUESTIONS for any covenant: parties / relationship established / Yahweh's promise / required response / sign / blessings-curses / duration / purpose in the developing story.

MAJOR FINDING THE SIDEBAR PRODUCED: BERIT OLAM attaches to THREE institutions — RAINBOW (Gen 9:16), CIRCUMCISION (Gen 17:13), SHABBAT (Ex 31:16). Same Hebrew phrase. NO tradition treats all three identically: nobody says the rainbow covenant ended; the apostles didn't require circumcision of Gentiles; Shabbat is contested. This STRENGTHENS the OLAM brake, does not relieve it — the phrase alone cannot settle any case. EXPLICITLY DOES NOT MEAN olam = 'temporary' (that's the Anti-Replacement error, swapping one rigid reading for its opposite). It means olam is NOT the load-bearing word everyone assumes. Removes the temptation to treat one lexical verdict as decisive for circumcision + Shabbat + Ezekiel 37's sanctuary simultaneously.
TRANSLATION INCONSISTENCY: ESV renders the identical phrase 'everlasting covenant' (Gen 9:16, 17:13) but 'covenant forever' (Ex 31:16). CJB: 'perpetual' at Ex 31:16, 'everlasting' at Gen 17:13. RVR1960 most consistent: 'perpetuo' both places.

NEW FORMAL RULE — THE COVENANT RELATIONSHIP RULE (now in 00b + 00-methodology-current as rule 5): LATER COVENANT != AUTOMATIC CANCELLATION of preceding covenants. EARLIER COVENANT != every feature retaining identical administration forever. SCRIPTURE MUST TELL US THE RELATIONSHIP; NEVER INFERRED FROM SEQUENCE ALONE. Decisive test case = THE RAINBOW, precisely because it's uncontroversial: nobody argues circumcision replaced the rainbow covenant, and the ONLY reason is that Scripture never says so. WARRANT: Galatians 3:17 — the law 'came 430 years afterward, does not annul a covenant previously ratified by God.' Paul himself reasons that later covenantal/legal development does not automatically nullify an earlier divine promise.

'ADDENDUM' INTUITION MODIFIED NOT REJECTED: addendum implies terms appended to one unchanged contract. The biblical form is Gal 3:17 — a claim about PROMISES NOT BEING ANNULLED. Covenant sequence: Noah (rainbow) -> Abraham (circumcision) -> Sinai (Torah/priesthood/sanctuary/sacrifice) -> David (house/throne/kingdom) -> New (Jer 31). Noah wasn't a failed first attempt; Sinai isn't 'Abraham 2.0'; David doesn't erase Abraham. Story becomes MORE SPECIFIC, concentrating toward Messiah. BUT Jeremiah adds what accumulation alone can't hold: a covenant genuinely BROKEN — yet Yahweh does NOT say everything prior is canceled. Continuity and discontinuity both preserved; neither half swallows the other. The Stage 15 refinement SURVIVES and is strengthened: 'one covenantal story containing multiple covenants, culminating in Messiah.'

TWO CJB TRANSLATION DATA RECORDED NOT ADOPTED: (1) diatheke rendered 'oath' at Gal 3:17 — interpretive, Greek is not horkos; (2) CJB inserts 'the legal part of the Torah' twice where ESV/RVR1960 read simply 'the law' — importing the very moral/civil/ceremonial-style partition that Category Collapse's SECOND FACE flags as theological taxonomy rather than biblical terminology.

REFRAMES STAGE 17 RETROACTIVELY: the circumcision question is NOT 'did Yahweh repeal a rule?' but 'WHAT HAPPENED TO THE SIGN'S COVENANTAL BOUNDARY-MARKER FUNCTION?' — which is why 00q section 20's classification produced NO row reading 'abolished'; every row describes a CHANGE IN FUNCTION.

SEQUENCE NOTE (ADR-0007 demonstration): 00r was written AFTER 00q but is numbered Stage 16.5 because the spine records ARGUMENT order while file letters record CREATION order. Nothing in Stage 17 was rewritten to pretend this came first. The two architectures are allowed to disagree — that is why both exist.
